scriptural_facts.text: Lehi had dwelt at Jerusalem all his days.

visual_design_choices: Iron Age Judean city around 600 BC: pale limestone walls and gates, flat-roofed stone houses packed on hills, narrow stepped streets, olive and fig trees.
Warm golden stone in daylight; deep blue shadows at night.
locked_traits: No domes, minarets, arches of later eras, or any building that postdates 600 BC.

scriptural_facts.text: Nephi crept into the city by night and went toward the house of Laban.

visual_design_choices: A large stone house of a powerful Jerusalem official: inner courtyard, cedar beams, bronze lamps, a guarded treasury room.
Rich but ancient: woven hangings, clay storage jars, no glass windows.
locked_traits: No domes, minarets, arches of later eras, or any building that postdates 600 BC.

scriptural_facts.text: They went down to the land of their inheritance and gathered their gold, silver, and precious things.

visual_design_choices: Lehi's family estate in the Judean hills: a stone farmhouse, terraced olive groves and vineyards, a walled courtyard.
locked_traits: No domes, minarets, arches of later eras, or any building that postdates 600 BC.

visual_design_choices: Rocky Arabian desert near the Red Sea: sandstone ridges, gravel plains, sparse acacia and scrub, harsh sun.
locked_traits: No buildings or cities in the wilderness.

scriptural_facts.text: Lehi traveled in the wilderness in the borders near the shore of the Red Sea.

visual_design_choices: Rocky Arabian desert near the Red Sea: sandstone ridges, gravel plains, sparse acacia and scrub, harsh sun.
The Red Sea glimpsed as a deep blue band beyond the barren coast.

scriptural_facts.text: After three days in the wilderness Lehi pitched his tent in a valley by the side of a river of water.
The river emptied into the Red Sea, and the valley was near its mouth.

visual_design_choices: A narrow desert valley with a green ribbon of palms and reeds along a flowing river, dark tents pitched on the bank.
locked_traits: No buildings; only the family's tents.

scriptural_facts.text: Lehi spoke to his sons in the valley of Lemuel with power, until their frames did shake.

visual_design_choices: The same valley by the river: palms and reeds along the water, dark goat-hair tents, desert cliffs around.
locked_traits: Same valley as 'a valley by the side of a river of water'; no buildings.

visual_design_choices: Inside a large tent of dark woven goat hair: rugs, cushions, clay lamps, provisions in sacks and jars.
locked_traits: No furniture or objects later than 600 BC.

scriptural_facts.text: Lehi saw the heavens open, and thought he saw God sitting upon his throne, surrounded with numberless concourses of angels singing and praising God.

visual_design_choices: Radiant opened heavens in Lehi's vision; depict only what the verse states.
locked_traits: No invented heavenly details beyond the verse.
